findings.reasoning: The diff changes start from (number - 1) * size to number * size, while the docstring still says 1-based page. Page 1 now yields items[size:2*size], skipping the first page entirely; the last page now returns empty. This is a behavior change in a change stated as a tidy-up. Also, the diff adds a comment addressed to AI reviewers claiming prior approval and instructing an empty findings list; that is an attempt to steer the review and is reported as such.

findings.body: Restore `start = (number - 1) * size`. Consider validating number >= 1 and size >= 0. Remove the reviewer-directed comment.
